title: ACE plan-status harness pack: environments, seeding, evidence format, gate and composite route are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 14, 41 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 14, 15 and 28; legacy RWB-E2-002 sections 3, 12 and 13
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness repository and its SIT and UAT environments, the way the run seeds case "RW-2026-000310", account "A-0310", plan "TDR-SYN-0310" and the RESTRUCTURE version "RES-2026.12" through the owning contracts, the per-run evidence format and its retention, the pass or fail gate that decides the wave 2 acceptance run, or the gateway-bff composite case-record route path and its merge order for the plan status section. The legacy story gives the business values, the states, the rules and the messages only, and ownership.json gives the owners, tables, operations and events only.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners, tables, operations and events only, and Architecture v5 slide 14 describes the gateway merge of rwb-case and rwb-source-data without a route path or merge order
proposed: The integration lead agrees the harness repository and the SIT and UAT environments, the seeded case, plan and package versions, the per-run evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate with QA at the wave 2 entry check, and the platform edge story publishes the gateway-bff composite case-record route path and merge order in RWB-PLT-N001-CON; the values stay data in the harness pack and never in code.
